turns.user_utterance: I believe my card has been stolen, what can I do about this situation? It's urgent.
turns.assistant_response: I’m really sorry this happened—let’s act immediately. Please freeze your card right now in the app (or use the card controls/lock feature), then report it as stolen/lost so we can help protect your funds. If you also suspect anyone has access to your phone or passcode, tell me—are you able to lock the card in the app right now?
